title: Representation along loop iterations
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape binary machine with states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $c$ be an initial configuration with a present state. Suppose a compiled configuration $d$ starts at the live exit anchor and represents $c$. For a natural number $r$, assume the machine has a present state at every time $u<r$. Let $e$ be the configuration obtained by iterating the compiled machine for $r$ rounds, each round lasting until it reaches an exit anchor. Then $e$ is at the exit anchor determined by whether the simulated machine is still running after $r$ steps, $e$ represents the simulated configuration at that time, and $e$ has the same output as $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers $k,n$ and binary input list $x$
